literal: Unsuspected with appearance, without fearing the eye, anywhere not spilling is indeed capable spy.
translation: A true spy is one who assumes an unsuspected appearance, looks without fear, and never lets secrets slip anywhere.
modern: யாராலும் சந்தேகிக்கப்படாத உருவத்துடன், யாருடைய பார்வைக்கும் அஞ்சாமல், எவ்விடத்திலும் ரகசியங்களை வெளிப்படுத்தாமல் இருக்க வல்லவனே சிறந்த ஒற்றன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a capable spy. The word 'கடாஅ' (unquestioned) combined with 'உருவொடு' (with an appearance) means the spy must adopt a disguise that arouses no suspicion. 'கண்ணஞ்சாது' indicates that they must not show fear in their eyes or shrink from the gaze of others. Finally, 'உகாஅமை' (not spilling) emphasizes their ability to keep secrets from leaking out, no matter where they are ('யாண்டும்'). Together, these traits make a spy truly effective.
